data.long_description:
Cove Edition 5 stands as a beacon of contemporary elegance in Dubailand. The development boasts fully furnished units designed with tasteful finishes, creating a perfect blend of luxury and practicality. With 11 residential floors rising above two parking levels and a stylish ground floor, the structure itself reflects the attention to detail and premium craftsmanship throughout.

Whether you're seeking a modern family home or a smart investment opportunity, Cove Edition 5 offers everything you need—rooftop leisure, modern amenities, and an unbeatable location within one of Dubai’s fastest-growing communities.
